<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Delimitation and representation:</strong> The Union government is pushing the Delimitation Bill—which includes a proposed 50% increase in Lok Sabha seats—amidst mixed support from regional parties like the DMK and BRS, and strong opposition from the Shiv Sena (UBT) regarding regional representation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNME1iN0NrcmtPZ2hQZ3JOU3RVWmJ1R2paVExJOVI1TEdzOEVKRG1fOFRHVDI0MUVDbVJpcGpfbUJCclJBbnBfTHlMeFBJbk9ZMUlSSUppTVdET3RZNVRsdVA0c1VtUEo5TF9lMHZ1dXVzQkFTQVlkcUdodlgxa3ZfTjZ3?oc=5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxQRnBZYTk5dTlTODd3cWpBZ3Zfa1pxTWVlUjQwTHZpY3Z1Y1FkQTVjNC14WkYtcmEySTdwRF91T3FicFBvVXhyclpPTUFXSnlFb29rQzVTaUtaS0ljWlAyMHRjMU1LMUlXemNLZnRmcWdZUHlWeVJ4Rjc4SVFhRnF6VWZHQ2ZQNDg4UUlfcWxsVVR1QQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W15</a></span></li>
